intuition: Place one queen per row and count only arrangements whose columns and diagonals are unused.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate every column permutation and reject arrangements with diagonal conflicts.

optimal.approach: Backtrack row by row while tracking occupied columns and the two diagonal keys in sets.

edge_cases: A one-cell board has one valid arrangement.
Boards of size two or three have no valid arrangement.
Count solutions without constructing board strings.
